caption: The drawing depicts a detailed front view of a piece of furniture, likely a cabinet or sideboard, executed in black ink on a beige or off-white paper background. The structure is rectangular and symmetrical, with two levels. The upper section features ornamental panels and columns: there are decorative horizontal bands at the very top and near the middle, both filled with intricate scrollwork. Below the topmost band are three main vertical sections: the two outer sections contain square panels with diamond and cross motifs, while the center section has a rectangular panel adorned with a foliage or floral design. These vertical sections are bordered by turned columns at either side. The lower section of the cabinet shows two large doors, each divided into two vertical panels. Each panel is decorated with repeated circular and leaf motifs, and the tops of the panels are finished with semicircular arches featuring embellished spandrels. At the bottom, there is a solid base with simple feet. The drawing is precisely outlined, showing detailed carvings and decorative elements, and at the bottom center, the text "SCALE ½ to. INCH" is written. The entire composition is monochromatic, using only line work without any shading or color.
title: Press Cupboard
